Description: The professional-boundary scanner checks rationale_text, assumptions, source, and actor, but it does not scan the full emitted operation, validation, audit, and diagnostic context copied into the rationale record. If upstream context contains unsupported authority language, the rationale record can preserve that text without a DEL-16-04 blocking diagnostic.
ProposedDisposition: Technically addressed: rationale claim scanning now includes operation envelope, validation context, audit trail, affected refs, and audit references before emitting the rationale record; copied prohibited authority language blocks the rationale record.
